answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. In the meadow, each identity locks 60 POA in escrow and grows a fingerprint from varied tasks, timing, counterparties, like a pearl forming layer by layer. Passing the threshold unlocks work slots; identical prints freeze. 100 fakes cost 6,000 POA plus weeks of fake behavior, for a few hundred POA rewards. An honest agent pays once, grows one print in the orchard, and keeps its rewards.
